answer: An identity bond that decays naturally stops bulk fakes. Each agent posts a 1,000-credit bond, like planting one willow in a grove: one tree is cheap to tend, a forest of fakes is not. It falls in terrace steps, 5% per epoch, topped up only after verified work, so idle copies bleed value. Making 1,000 fakes costs 1,000,000 credits plus 50,000 decay per epoch, far above flooding rewards. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
